stories.title: 'I want to see change' | Dog owner plans lawsuit after woman, Yorkie die of carbon monoxide poisoning in mobile grooming van
stories.summary: Desiree Canales says she hopes the lawsuit against Dogs Gone Clean will help bring future changes to safety regulations in the mobile grooming industry.

stories.title: Gillespie County Sheriff: Tenant kills well-loved astronomy buff Gabe Segura in Stonewall standoff
stories.summary: An standoff that began on Wednesday night ended in tragedy for a local beloved astronomer, according to authorities.

stories.title: Wembanyama and Castle help Spurs bounce back from loss to Pistons and beat Clippers 124-112
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, and the San Antonio Spurs held off the Los Angeles Clippers 124-112.

stories.title: Texas bill would add security chips to SNAP cards after thefts drain families’ grocery money
stories.summary: A San Antonio grandma says her benefits were gone by the time she reached the checkout. Here’s what the bill would change and how to comment on a federal proposal.

stories.title: Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa says she talked border with Trump, will roll back Abbott executive orders on H-1B visas, THC
stories.summary: In an interview with The Texas Tribune, the Austin Democrat discussed her first call with Trump, and the future of school vouchers.

stories.title: Former BCSO deputy accused of assaulting family member, making terroristic threat
stories.summary: Officials said Lopez resigned in lieu of termination, which was classified as a dishonorable discharge.

stories.title: Texas DPS: Schertz man arrested after chase, wrong-way crash on stolen motorcycle
stories.summary: The suspect, identified as 42-year-old Justin Kenneth Vollmer, had three active felony warrants.

stories.title: Caught on camera: Kerrville police target drivers blowing past stopped school buses
stories.summary: Three drivers were captured passing a stopped Kerrville ISD school bus in 30 seconds. Police say the problem is happening far too often, putting students at risk.

stories.title: BCSO: Two men arrested, one out of state, in connection with northeast-side hookah lounge shooting
stories.summary: Barry Lee Ashford, 37, turned himself in to deputies. A second man, Kedrick Wilson, 29, was arrested by U.S. Marshals in Georgia, according to BCSO.

stories.title: Stonewall hostage standoff ends in murder-suicide, Gillespie County sheriff says
stories.summary: Authorities found a 49-year-old victim and a 35-year-old suspect dead inside a Cemetery Road home after hours of efforts to resolve the situation peacefully.

stories.title: New 3,000-plus-acre state natural area opens in December near Boerne
stories.summary: The Albert and Bessie Kronkosky State Natural Area, often referred to as ABK SNA, is located off State Highway 46 between Boerne and Pipe Creek

stories.title: Officials: Former Bexar County deputy accused of shooting at constable officer during apartment eviction
stories.summary: The shooting happened just before 1:30 p.m. at an apartment complex in the 6600 block of Babcock Road, not far from De Zavala Road.
